items.name: Playwright Browser Runtime (On-demand)
items.notes: This entry documents the optional runtime-installed browser payload used for first-use browser automation. It is not part of the default packaged distribution.
items.inlineNoticeText: ADDOM no longer ships a Playwright-managed browser runtime by default. If Chromium is installed on demand into user data at runtime, preserve the upstream browser licenses and notices that accompany that payload for that local installation flow.
